fallback.label: General or emerging occupation
evidencePrompts: What does a strong performer in this work deliver?
What problems, people, tools, standards, or risks define the work?
What became better because of your contribution?

domains.label: Software engineering and cloud
evidencePrompts: What system or feature did you build or change, and what constraint mattered?
What did you improve in reliability, latency, quality, security, cost, or developer experience?

domains.label: Data, AI, and analytics
evidencePrompts: What decision changed because of your analysis?
How did you improve data quality, model performance, reporting, experimentation, or insight delivery?

domains.label: Cybersecurity and IT
evidencePrompts: What incident, risk, control, or reliability problem did you handle?
What environment, standards, tools, and response responsibilities were involved?

domains.label: Product management
evidencePrompts: What customer or business problem did you prioritize, and why?
What discovery, experiment, roadmap, launch, or adoption evidence shows your contribution?

domains.label: Project and program management
evidencePrompts: What program or delivery did you coordinate, and what dependencies or risks did you manage?
How did schedule, budget, quality, scope, or stakeholder alignment change?

domains.label: Design and creative
evidencePrompts: What user or communication problem did the work solve?
What research, iteration, accessibility, craft, or portfolio evidence supports the outcome?

domains.label: Marketing and communications
evidencePrompts: What audience and goal did the campaign address?
What changed in reach, engagement, qualified demand, conversion, reputation, or message clarity?

domains.label: Sales and business development
evidencePrompts: What market, account type, territory, or sales motion did you own?
What evidence shows pipeline quality, revenue, retention, expansion, negotiation, or relationship depth?

domains.label: Customer success and support
evidencePrompts: What customer problem or adoption barrier did you resolve?
What shows retention, satisfaction, resolution quality, response, expansion, or process improvement?

domains.label: Finance and accounting
evidencePrompts: What financial decision, close, control, forecast, or analysis did you support?
What scale, accuracy, timeliness, compliance, savings, or risk evidence can you confirm?

domains.label: Banking and investment
evidencePrompts: What transaction, portfolio, research, diligence, or client work did you contribute to?
What size, sector, model, thesis, risk, or decision can be described without breaching confidentiality?

domains.label: Consulting and strategy
evidencePrompts: What ambiguous problem did you structure and solve?
What analysis, recommendation, implementation, stakeholder, or decision outcome followed?

domains.label: Legal, compliance, and policy
evidencePrompts: What matter, regulation, contract, investigation, or policy did you handle?
What jurisdiction, risk, analysis, negotiation, control, or outcome can be stated appropriately?

domains.label: Operations, supply chain, and logistics
evidencePrompts: What flow of people, materials, orders, inventory, or service did you improve?
What evidence shows throughput, reliability, cost, quality, safety, delivery, or supplier performance?

domains.label: Manufacturing, engineering, and quality
evidencePrompts: What process, equipment, design, production, or quality problem did you solve?
Which standards, tolerances, safety constraints, reliability measures, or production results applied?

domains.label: Construction, skilled trades, and field service
evidencePrompts: What projects, systems, equipment, or sites did you work on?
What licenses, safety practices, diagnostics, workmanship, schedule, or customer evidence shows your capability?

domains.label: Clinical healthcare
evidencePrompts: What patient population, setting, acuity, or clinical responsibility did you handle?
What evidence shows safety, care quality, coordination, education, documentation, or improvement without exposing patient information?

domains.label: Public health and social care
evidencePrompts: What population, caseload, program, or safeguarding responsibility did you support?
What shows access, continuity, engagement, coordination, prevention, or community outcome?

domains.label: Pharma, biotech, and life sciences
evidencePrompts: What study, assay, product, submission, quality system, or scientific problem did you work on?
What methods, regulations, reproducibility, documentation, or milestone evidence applies?

domains.label: Education and training
evidencePrompts: Who learned what because of your teaching or design?
What evidence shows learner progress, inclusion, engagement, curriculum quality, assessment, or program improvement?

domains.label: Academic and research
evidencePrompts: What research question, method, dataset, experiment, or contribution did you own?
What publication, grant, presentation, teaching, collaboration, reproducibility, or impact evidence is verified?

domains.label: Government and public sector
evidencePrompts: What public outcome, service, policy, casework, or statutory responsibility did you support?
What shows compliance, stewardship, access, timeliness, stakeholder trust, or measurable service improvement?

domains.label: Nonprofit and social impact
evidencePrompts: What community need, program, campaign, partnership, or funding goal did you address?
What shows reach, service quality, participation, funding, sustainability, or beneficiary outcome?

domains.label: Retail, hospitality, and service
evidencePrompts: What customer, guest, service, or shift responsibility did you own?
What shows service quality, sales, speed, hygiene, safety, teamwork, training, or repeat business?

domains.label: Administrative and office support
evidencePrompts: What people, schedules, records, communications, or processes did you keep running?
What shows accuracy, discretion, responsiveness, organization, time saved, or stakeholder trust?

domains.label: Executive and enterprise leadership
evidencePrompts: What enterprise decision, operating model, portfolio, or transformation did you lead?
What verified scope and durable outcomes show leadership across strategy, people, governance, and execution?
